entries.evidence: The speed key (startkey.ldr, its 11L axle p3540 23948) lies on the ground in the file. Book 2 page 310 (42083-1-2.pdf) shows it in place: the axle goes 3 to 4 studs into a hole above and behind the left rear hub, likely the 59443 p2099, into the shaft under the wing (docs/audits, the build-step answers; medium, measured on a perspective picture). Placed with the axle along that hole's line (x, at y -143, z 440), 3.5 studs (70 LDU) in from its outer face at x 210, its tip at x 140; the key's turn about the axle is as built.
